requirement_table.text: ID register at 0x000 reads 0x20960001.
BUILD register at 0x004 reads the USR_ACCESSE2 word.
SCRATCH at 0x008 reads back the written 32-bit value.
SCRATCH resets to 0.
Unmapped addresses read 0.
Writes to unmapped addresses change no register.
h_rdata shows the addressed register within 2 clocks of h_re.
h_rdata holds its value until the next h_re.
SEL resets to 0.
SEL 0 selects clock A and SEL 1 selects clock B.
STATUS bit 1 ACTIVE_SEL equals the clock driving the muxed domain.
STATUS bit 0 SWITCHING is 1 from a SEL change until ACTIVE_SEL equals SEL.
B_DIV reads a value from 1 to 8 equal to the divide applied to the GT reference clock.
The muxed clock has no glitch or runt pulse across a switch.
MUX_ERRS stays 0 across 1,000 random switches.
Any mismatch between the binary counter and its Gray twin adds 1 to MUX_ERRS.
A counter step that is not exactly +1 adds 1 to MUX_ERRS.
SWITCH_COUNT increments by 1 per change of ACTIVE_SEL.
A SEL write equal to the current selection leaves SWITCH_COUNT unchanged.
GATE_LEN resets to 25,000,000.
GATE_LEN reads back the written 32-bit value.
START sets BUSY for exactly GATE_LEN C3 cycles then sets DONE.
FREQ_COUNT equals the muxed-clock rising edges in the gate, within 1 edge.
START self-clears after one clock.
A write to SNAPSHOT latches the low 32 bits of the muxed counter into MUX_COUNT.
sfp_tx_disable is 1 at all times.
The design uses no GT transceiver channel.
The clk_c3 domain meets timing at 25 MHz with WNS at or above 0.
jtag_bus.sv is instantiated unchanged.
